english_llm

- delta2: Return structured tool calls, never plain text responses. Decoder expects valid AST format, not conversational fallbacks.

multilingual_llm
- delta1: Creative writing (poems, stories, narratives) are self-contained; generate directly without tool invocation unless factual grounding is explicitly requested.

search_engine
- delta1: Skip search for pure creative tasks (poetry, fiction). Only invoke if user explicitly requests facts, research, or external data integration.
